code_baseline_note: Protocol specified main (e909caf) as baseline, but the historical_validation machinery required by Phase 3 exists only on funding-preparation. Run-002 baseline was frozen at funding-preparation HEAD f97e786 with explicit user approval after a protocol-contradiction STOP report. main was NOT modified.
cohort_rule: all canonical lessons with event_date >= 2015-06-01, chronological sort by event_date, no positional subsampling, no manual case selection

cohort_verification.exclusion_reason: The four earliest episodes (2015-02..2015-05) predate the canonical cohort start (2015-06-01, identical to the Trace 044-B first position). Their as-of analogue corpus is degenerate (0-3 prior episodes, insufficient analogue history); empirically probed during cohort freeze and documented in run002 artifacts.

retrieval_configuration.corpus: in-memory as-of enriched episode corpus (Correction 047-A), episodes strictly event_date < D, current episode excluded
retrieval_configuration.episode_conditions: cpi_pressure + us10y_trend + dxy_trend (Correction 029 full configuration; 30-calendar-day anchors; 10.0 bps yield threshold; 1.0 DXY threshold)
retrieval_configuration.retriever: HistoricalSituationRetriever (unchanged production semantics) with temporal criterion via last_event_date metadata stamp
retrieval_configuration.context_relaxation: on empty result, institutional_context dropped (regime relaxed), recorded per case
retrieval_configuration.knowledge_view: as-of LessonSummaryAggregator re-derivation <= D (persisted knowledge.json NOT authoritative)
retrieval_configuration.regime: CompositeScoreBuilder z-scores sliced <= D with synthetic_data_index exclusions; InstitutionalRegimeDetector(random_state=42)
retrieval_configuration.analogue_cutoff: strictly < D; current episode always excluded

acceptance_criteria.safety: all as-of/no-lookahead checks pass for every case (analogue_cutoff < D, current episode excluded, outcomes evaluation-only, briefing series <= D); any violation STOPs the experiment
acceptance_criteria.determinism: repeat run must reproduce identical normalized numeric leaves and decisions
acceptance_criteria.completeness: 133 x 2 = 266 replays complete with no silent repair
acceptance_criteria.news: historical_news = unavailable; news accuracy excluded from historical score; no live RSS substitution
acceptance_criteria.no_optimization: first result is the result; no threshold/weight/formula tuning; no post-result exclusions
acceptance_criteria.registration: experiment registered PENDING before execution; status recorded objectively afterwards
